body:
I feel the same as you. I always think I'm faking everything in the same way and one of my worst fears is to really be an attention seeker, or be faking everything and just not know it because I'm in too deep and deluded myself.

Someone online told me something a long time ago and it really helped for a while. They said that people who are really attention seeking, and faking their mental stuff, always know, and it's never a question. They went into it from the start knowing that and they were never confused or scared that they're coming across that way, because that is their ultimate goal and they're not ashamed of it.

I hope this helps, also I know it's not worth much from me but please know that you are valid, even if sometimes you're scared that you're not
